product.title: Musical Masterpiece Society Classical Vinyl Record Lot of 10 Mozart Bach Haydn
product.description:
Musical Masterpiece Society — Vintage Classical Collection

Carefully graded and play-tested.

Ten vintage 33⅓RPM classical vinyl records with coordinated illustrated Musical Masterpiece Society jackets. Discs carry Musical Masterpiece Society / Musical Masterworks Society label variations.

Condition

Owner reports all ten records were played and play through without skipping. Vinyl varies, approximately VG- to VG+ by owner assessment, with visible marks and scratches and occasional surface crackle/noise. These are not uniformly VG+ records. Jackets show foxing, yellowing, spotting, discoloration, edge/corner wear and handling marks. Bach Organ Recital (MMS-32) has black tape and writing; Haydn Symphony No.96 (MMS-6) has handwritten notes. Please inspect all 24 photographs closely.

Details

Exact pressing years and first-pressing status have not been established. No first-pressing claim is made. Bare collection measures approximately 10½ × 10½ × 1¾ inches and weighs 4 lb 10 oz.

Included recordings and performers

  1. Mozart — Piano Concerto No. 24 in C Minor, K. 491 (MMS-46). Grant Johannesen; Netherlands Philharmonic Orchestra; Otto Ackermann
  2. Beethoven — Sonata No. 9 in A Major, Op. 47 — Kreutzer (MMS-18). Oliver Colbentson; David Garvey
  3. J. S. Bach — Organ Recital (MMS-32). Alexander Schreiner; Salt Lake Tabernacle; jacket has black tape
  4. Mozart — Clarinet Quintet in A Major, K. 581 (MMS-37). Peter Simenauer; Pascal String Quartet
  5. Haydn — Symphonies Nos. 94 and 100 (MMS-59). Netherlands Philharmonic Orchestra; Henry Swoboda
  6. Mozart — Symphony No. 36 in C Major, K. 425 — Linz (MMS-1). Winterthur Symphony Orchestra; Walter Goehr
  7. J. S. Bach — Magnificat in D Major (MMS-31). Walter Reinhart; Zurich and Winterthur choruses and orchestra
  8. Chopin — Piano Concerto No. 2 in F Minor, Op. 21 (MMS-4). Mewton-Wood; Radio Zurich Orchestra; Walter Goehr
  9. Haydn — Symphony No. 96 — Miracle; Isola Disabitata Overture (MMS-6). Winterthur Symphony Orchestra; Walter Goehr; jacket has handwriting
  10. Bizet — Symphony in C Major (MMS-11). Utrecht Symphony Orchestra; Paul Hupperts

Included

All ten records and their illustrated jackets, sold together as one lot. Inner-sleeve originality is not established.

Packing & Shipping

Discs protected in inner sleeves, packed flat with rigid cardboard reinforcement, edge protection and moisture protection. Buyer-paid calculated USPS Media Mail shipping. Two-business-day handling. Returns accepted within 30 days; buyer pays return shipping.
